name: Ciudad de México

standard.note: Mexico City's everyday plate is white with black characters, a maroon 'Ciudad de México' legend beside the city and SEMOVI shields, and a QR code in the corner.

plates.title: Current design (2016)
plates.fact: Mexico City's everyday plate is white with black characters, a maroon 'Ciudad de México' legend beside the city and SEMOVI shields, and a QR code in the corner.

plates.title: World Cup 2026 commemorative
plates.fact: Only 60,000 were made, in black, white and yellow versions with an axolotl in a feather headdress, hummingbirds, flowers and the Sun Stone.

plates.title: Hybrid and electric vehicles
plates.fact: SEMOVI issues a separate plate set for hybrid and electric cars.

plates.title: Antique cars (auto antiguo)
plates.fact: The plate shows an old car and the words 'auto antiguo'.

plates.title: Drivers with disabilities
plates.fact: Both plates carry the international disability symbol.

notes: semovi.cdmx.gob.mx, jefaturadegobierno.cdmx.gob.mx and placasmundial2026.cdmx.gob.mx would not load in the browser, and WebFetch refused them, so no SEMOVI image or robot page could be checked. The hybrid-plate SEMOVI page URL comes from a search snippet; the page itself wasn't read. The World Cup image is the city's own close-up photo of the black plate (1200x800), not flat artwork; it was on sale from 9 Mar 2026. The year 2016 is when the current layout's manual came out (chilango, Jul 2016); later batches swapped in newer government logos, so check that. In Oct 2025 SEMOVI denied any mass reemplacamiento. Design description from sdpnoticias/unotv (2025).
